summary.text: Bill Bridgeo is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives who has represented District 60 since December 6, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career experience includes working as a government administrator.

paragraphs.text: Bill Bridgeo earned a high school diploma from Marianhill High School, a bachelor's degree from St. Michael's College in 1972, and an M.P.A. from the University of Hartford in 1979.
He was assigned to the Environment and Natural Resources Committee in 2023-2024 and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
